create_minicpmv_model: create a MiniCPMV multimodal model instance from a VllmConfig for inference with images and videos
build_resampler_2_5: build a Resampler2_5 module that compresses vision features via cross-attention with 2D positional embeddings
build_resampler_4_5: build a Resampler4_5 module extending Resampler2_5 with temporal positional embeddings for high-refresh-rate video
parse_multimodal_inputs: parse and validate multimodal pixel and embedding inputs for MiniCPMV vision processing
process_multimodal_data: process images and videos through the HuggingFace processor to produce tokenized inputs and field configs
